objective: Extend target-independent divisor-kernel discovery and, conditionally, scalar-blind recovery beyond degree 15.

search_space.sizing_reason: dimension 12 is the smallest available invariant divisor dimension with two times dimension at least 23

candidate_source: all degree-12 divisors of T^23-1 over F2 on both public Koblitz curve variants
admission: curve construction succeeds and the factor-base cofactor classes can sum to zero with exactly two summands
selection_rule: among all admitted curve/divisor candidates, maximize rational factor-base points; then minimize projected signed-Frobenius columns; then choose lower curve_a and lexicographically lower divisor indices
execution: one charged fresh process per curve variant
decision_gate: Freeze a separate unknown-scalar run only after both curve processes terminate and a winner is selected by the frozen public rule.
claim_boundary: A degree-23 public census or toy completion is not a scaling law, crossover, novelty or SOTA result.
